name: slimtoken-fuzz
description: In-process fuzz campaign sidecar for the SlimToken engine: mutates engine-drafted seed corpora against a target's fuzz(input) entry point and reports crashes. Zero tokens, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.selftest: node bin/slimtoken-fuzz.mjs help && node --check lib/fuzz.mjs && node --check lib/report.mjs && node test/selftest.mjs
